component.name: JMS
component.summary: A Jellyfin client with Seerr requests and offline downloads

description.p: JMS connects to your Jellyfin server to browse and play your media library. It is based on Fladder and includes Seerr media requests and issue reports.

ul.li: Video playback with subtitles and ambient lighting
Offline media downloads and settings backup
Multiple server accounts and secure Seerr session storage

description.p: Enter your own service addresses in the application. Linux Flatpak updates are managed by Flatpak.
Adds a Linux x86_64 Flatpak package with bundled media libraries and secure desktop session storage.
